description: This file defines the DRMConnector class which interacts with the Direct Rendering Manager (DRM) to manage display connectors. It includes functions for querying display modes, selecting preferred or best modes, and determining connection status, resolution, and refresh rate.

classes.name: DRMConnector
classes.description: Represents a DRM display connector, providing access to connection status, resolution, and refresh rate. It initializes by opening the DRM device, querying available connectors of a specified type, and selecting display modes based on preferences.

methods.name: DRMConnector(const std::string&, uint32_t, bool)
methods.description: Constructor that opens the DRM device, retrieves resources, and initializes connector information based on the specified type and mode preference.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the connector is currently connected.

methods.name: Height
methods.description: Returns the height of the selected display mode.

methods.name: Width
methods.description: Returns the width of the selected display mode.

methods.name: RefreshRate
methods.description: Returns the refresh rate of the selected display mode.

methods.name: InitializeWithConnector
methods.description: Initializes connector parameters using a DRM connector and mode selection based on preference.

methods.name: BestMode
methods.description: Selects the display mode with the largest area (hdisplay * vdisplay).

methods.name: PreferredMode
methods.description: Selects the preferred display mode marked with DRM_MODE_TYPE_PREFERRED.
